minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a special permit for a garage-and-apartment addition at 36 Summer Street with a reduced side setback.
minutes.summary: The board heard Peter M Kelly's application to add two garage bays with an apartment above at 36 Summer Street, in the Summer Street overlay district. Members questioned the commercial use, the five-foot side yard against the fifteen-foot standard, rental plans, egress and fire access. A motion to grant the permit with prior conditions and Board of Health requirements was made and seconded, and the permit was announced as granted. The board then adjourned.
